name: Boat Winterization
description: Starter checklist for seasonal boat winterization and spring recommission.

reminders.title: Winterize Engine & Fuel System
reminders.notes: Stabilize fuel, fog cylinders if required, and drain/flush cooling system per manufacturer guidance.

reminders.title: Drain & Protect Water Systems
reminders.notes: Drain fresh water / raw-water systems and add antifreeze where appropriate.

reminders.title: Battery Storage Check
reminders.notes: Remove or disconnect batteries; store on a maintainer if possible.

reminders.title: Spring Recommission
reminders.notes: Reinstall batteries, flush antifreeze, check fluids, and verify bilge / safety equipment before launch.
